zh: 同一组引脚，为什么会有三种线长？
en: How can the same set of pins have three different wirelengths?

zh: 这一课，我们用三把不同的尺子，看懂芯片布局里的网络模型。
en: In this lesson, we use three different rulers to understand net models in chip placement.

zh: 在芯片里，一个网络可以同时连接多个引脚。
en: A net on a chip can connect several pins at once.

zh: 连接关系已经确定，布局决定它们的位置。
en: The connections are already specified; placement chooses their positions.

zh: 估计线长之前，我们还需要选定测量模型。
en: Before estimating wirelength, we must also choose a measurement model.

zh: 先用四个可以手算的点。A、B、C、D，放在边长为二的正方形四角。
en: Start with four pins at the corners of a square of side two.

zh: 全课用同一个例子，比较包围盒、完全图和星形模型。
en: We use these same coordinates throughout, comparing a bounding box, a clique, and a star.

zh: 本课使用曼哈顿距离。它不是两点间的直线距离，而是横向差的绝对值，加竖向差的绝对值。
en: We use Manhattan distance, rather than straight-line distance. Add the absolute horizontal difference to the absolute vertical difference.

zh: 图中的折线是测量示意。
en: The bent lines in our drawings illustrate that measurement.

zh: 从左下角的 A 到右上角的 D，横向走二，竖向也走二，所以距离为四。
en: From A at the lower left to D at the upper right, move two units horizontally and two vertically. Their Manhattan distance is four.

zh: 先把这把小尺子固定，后面的求和才有相同口径。
en: Every model here uses this same basic distance.

zh: 第一种模型，先找到所有引脚的最小包围盒。
en: The first model finds the smallest box containing all pins.

zh: 最左、最右确定宽，最下、最上确定高。
en: The leftmost and rightmost pins determine its width. The lowest and highest determine its height.

zh: 半周长线长，就是宽加高。
en: Add width and height.

zh: 在这个正方形上，宽是二，高也是二，半周长是四。注意，是半周长。
en: For our square, width and height are both two, giving a half-perimeter wirelength of four.

zh: 沿着四条边绕完整一圈会得到八，那不是这里的指标。
en: Walking around all four sides gives eight. That is the full perimeter, not this metric.

zh: 无论有多少引脚，包围盒只需要四个极值。
en: The bounding box needs only four extreme coordinates.

zh: 扫描每个引脚一次，就能得到结果。
en: Scan each pin once to find them, so the computation grows linearly with the number of pins.

zh: 所以它计算便宜，适合快速估计网络的线长。
en: It is a cheap wirelength estimate.

zh: 第二种模型叫完全图模型，也叫克利克模型。它把每对不同引脚都连起来。
en: The second model is a clique: connect every pair of distinct pins and add their Manhattan distances.

zh: 四个引脚共有六对，同一对只计算一次。
en: Four pins give six unordered pairs. Count each pair exactly once.

zh: 按字母顺序，先算 A 到 B、A 到 C、A 到 D，再算 B 到 C、B 到 D，最后算 C 到 D。
en: In alphabetical order, measure A to B, A to C, and A to D; then B to C, B to D, and C to D.

zh: 六个距离依次是二、二、四、四、二、二。
en: The six distances are two, two, four, four, two, and two.

zh: 把六项相加，完全图模型的总和是十六。
en: Adding these six terms gives sixteen.

zh: 不要把 A 到 B 和 B 到 A 各加一遍，否则会重复计数，结果变成三十二。
en: Do not count both A to B and B to A. Those names describe the same unordered pair; double counting would incorrectly produce thirty-two.

zh: 当引脚数为 p，完全图有 p 乘 p 减一，再除以二条边。
en: With p pins, a clique has p times p minus one, divided by two edges.

zh: 这里使用没有归一化的曼哈顿距离总和，不是后续二次布局里的平方距离目标。
en: Here we sum unnormalized Manhattan distances. This is not the squared-distance objective used in quadratic placement.

zh: 第三种是星形模型。
en: The third model is a star.

zh: 先选一个现有引脚作中心，再把它连到其他引脚。
en: Choose one existing pin as a hub and connect it to every other pin.

zh: 本课把 A 作为中心，没有额外加入虚拟节点。
en: Our example uses A. We do not introduce a virtual center.

zh: 中心是 A 时，只需要 A 到 B、A 到 C、A 到 D 三条辐条。
en: With A as the hub, the spokes are A to B, A to C, and A to D.

zh: 距离分别是二、二、四，总和为八。
en: Their lengths are two, two, and four, totaling eight.

zh: 其余引脚之间的距离不进入这个和。
en: Other pin pairs do not enter this sum.

zh: 星形模型只有 p 减一条辐条，计算量与引脚数成正比。
en: A star has only p minus one spokes, so its computation is linear in the pin count.

zh: 但不要忘记，选择哪个中心，也是模型定义的一部分。
en: But the hub is part of the model definition.

zh: 报告数字时要写清楚。
en: Always name it when reporting the result.

zh: 现在，同一组点得到了四、十六、八。
en: The same pins now give four, sixteen, and eight.

zh: 连接没有改变，坐标也没有改变，只是求和方式不同。
en: Neither their coordinates nor their connections changed. Only the measurement changed.

zh: 这些数不能直接用来给模型排优劣。
en: These numbers alone cannot rank which model is better.

zh: 标准正方形里，四个角作星形中心，结果恰好一样。
en: For the square, choosing any corner as the star hub happens to give the same answer.

zh: 这个现象来自对称性。
en: That is a consequence of symmetry.

zh: 换成一张不对称的图，我们就能看见中心的影响。
en: An asymmetric example reveals why the hub matters.

zh: 在这组坐标里，A、B、C、D 作中心，星形值分别为十六、二十二、十四、二十。
en: Using A, B, C, and D as hubs now gives sixteen, twenty-two, fourteen, and twenty.

zh: 最小值在 C。
en: C has the smallest value here.

zh: 它说明中心重要，并没有证明某种布局算法最优。
en: This shows hub dependence; it does not prove a placement algorithm is optimal.

zh: 再看内部点的例子。A、B、C 支撑着八乘八的包围盒，让 D 从内部的四、四，移动到二、二。
en: Next, A, B, and C support an eight by eight bounding box. Move the interior pin D from four, four to two, two.

zh: 观察三把尺子，谁发生了变化。
en: Watch the three rulers: which readings change?

zh: 移动之后，半周长仍是十六，因为最外面的边界没有变。
en: The half-perimeter stays sixteen because the outer boundaries did not change.

zh: 完全图从五十六降到五十二，星形从二十四降到二十。
en: The clique decreases from fifty-six to fifty-two, and the star from twenty-four to twenty.

zh: 模型对位置的敏感性不同。
en: Different models respond differently to the same move.

zh: 如果把所有引脚挤到同一个位置，三个线长都变成零。
en: Place every pin at one position and all three wirelengths become zero.

zh: 但真实单元有面积，不能任意重叠。
en: Real cells have area and cannot freely overlap.

zh: 线长模型没有替你检查密度、重叠和时序。
en: These measurements have not checked density, overlap, or timing.

zh: 图上的折线只用于表示测量关系，不是最终的共享布线路径。
en: The bent lines illustrate measurement relationships, not final shared routing paths.

zh: 比较两个布局之前，先确认使用相同模型、相同距离、相同权重，以及相同的约束。
en: Before comparing two placement candidates, align the model, the distance, the weights, and the constraints. Small numbers need a clear definition.

zh: 回到网页，载入分散正方形，再载入标准正方形。
en: On the website, load the spread square and then the compact reference square.

zh: 三种读数从十六、六十四、三十二，变成四、十六、八。
en: The readings change from sixteen, sixty-four, thirty-two to four, sixteen, eight.

zh: 你也可以自己拖动一个点，实时检查。
en: Drag a pin to investigate your own placement.

zh: 试着更换星形中心，移动内部点，再完成六个实验任务。
en: Change the star hub, move the interior pin, and try the six experiment tasks.

zh: 每次先写下自己的预测，再读程序给出的每一项，解释变化是从哪里来的。
en: Write down your prediction first. Then inspect each computed contribution and explain where the change came from.

zh: 最后，用可下载的 Python 练习实现三个函数，和独立参考程序核对。
en: Finally, implement the three functions in the downloadable Python exercise and compare with the independent reference.

zh: 比记住四、十六、八更重要的，是你能说清楚，每个数字究竟量了什么。
en: More important than remembering four, sixteen, and eight is explaining exactly what each number measures.
